mapper.insert: INSERT INTO erp_user (user_code, user_id, user_name, user_phone, password_hash, salt, type, use_yn, is_han, is_book, is_clinic, role_key, center_code, created_at) VALUES (#{userCode}, #{userId}, #{userName}, #{userPhone}, #{passwordHash}, #{salt}, #{type}, #{useYn}, #{han}, #{book}, #{clinic}, #{roleKey}, #{centerCode}, SYSDATETIME())
mapper.select: SELECT u.user_code as userCode, u.user_id as userId, u.user_name as userName, u.role_key as roleKey, u.type as type, c.center_code as centerCode, c.center_name as centerName, r.region_name as regionName, role.role_num as roleNum FROM ERP_USER u JOIN ERP_CENTER c ON u.center_code = c.center_code JOIN ERP_REGION_CODE r ON c.region_key = r.region_key JOIN ERP_USER_ROLE_CODE role ON role.role_key = u.role_key WHERE u.user_id = #{userId}
SELECT menu_id FROM erp_menu_auth WHERE user_code = #{userCode} AND can_read = 'Y'
SELECT u.user_code as userCode, u.user_id as userId, u.password_hash as passwordHash, u.center_code as centerCode, u.salt as salt, u.use_yn as useYn FROM ERP_USER u WHERE u.user_id = #{userId}

select u.id, u.created_at, u.user_code, u.user_id, u.user_name, u.center_code, u.role_key from ERP_USER u JOIN erp_user_role_code r ON u.role_key = r.role_key where center_code = #{centerCode} AND (#{roleNum} = 4 OR #{userCode} = 'PUS002jumnea' OR (#{roleNum} = 3 AND (#{type} = 'all' OR u.type = #{type})) OR (#{roleNum} = 2 AND (#{type} = 'all' OR u.type = #{type})) OR (#{roleNum} = 1 AND u.user_code = #{userCode}) )
select u.id, u.created_at, u.user_code, u.user_id, u.user_name, u.center_code, u.role_key, u.type, u.is_han, u.is_book from ERP_USER u where center_code = #{centerCode} and use_yn = '1'
SELECT user_code, user_id, user_name, role_key, user_phone, use_yn, is_han, is_book, type, created_at FROM erp_user WHERE center_code = #{centerCode}
SELECT * FROM erp_menus order by sort_order
